headline: UK October Inflation Rises to 3.6% Driven by Surging Fuel Costs
summary: UK consumer price inflation accelerated to 3.6% year-on-year in October from 3.5% in September, lifted by higher petrol and record diesel prices despite slowing food inflation.
why: Inflation metrics guide the Bank of England's monetary policy decisions and influence UK government bond yields.

impacts.name: UK 10-year Gilt yield
impacts.why: Higher inflation readings diminish expectations for upcoming Bank of England interest rate cuts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Inflation exceeding central bank targets reduced investor expectations for near-term interest rate cuts.
